title: Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.30897v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive generative training can preserve sample counts in a rare region while silently eroding its characteristic core. Mapping this finite-horizon collapse across real-data quotas, rare prevalences, and feedback perturbations via exhaustive multi-generation chains is computationally prohibitive. We develop a decoupled framework that forecasts multi-generation collapse probabilities and locates operating risk boundaries from independent single-generation conditional fits alone. Pairing an exact three-source multinomial count law with single-generation response banks propagates count marginals in closed form, backed by explicit calibration-error and boundary-resolution bounds. For additive Gaussian perturbations, we further prove that equal-variance all-row and sparse policies reverse their boundary-crossing order at a unique hyperplane distance. translated_title: 从单代生成校准预测递归生成训练中的稀有模式坍缩
translated_abstract: 递归生成训练可能在稀有区域保持样本数量，同时在暗中侵蚀其特征核心。若要通过穷举多代生成链来刻画这种有限时域坍缩在不同真实数据配额、稀有流行度和反馈扰动下的表现，计算代价高得令人望而却步。我们开发了一个解耦框架，仅凭独立的单代条件拟合即可预测多代坍缩概率并定位运行风险边界。通过将精确的三源多项式计数定律与单代响应库相结合，能够以闭式形式传播计数边际分布，并辅以明确的校准误差界和边界分辨率界。对于加性高斯扰动，我们进一步证明：等方差的全行策略与稀疏策略会在某个唯一的超平面距离处反转其穿越边界的先后顺序。在一个包含2,178个设置规模的计数基准测试中，精确传播显著降低了风险平均绝对误差（MAE）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种解耦框架，仅凭单代生成的条件校准即可闭式预测递归生成训练中稀有模式的多代坍缩概率与运行风险边界，从而避免了代价高昂的多代穷举模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decoupled framework that predicts multi-generation rare-mode collapse probabilities and operating risk boundaries in recursive generative training in closed form from single-generation calibration alone, avoiding costly exhaustive multi-generation simulations.
